description:

Secret training, special operations, and amazing technology used by the FBI are exposed; most notorious agents; how the Internet age has changed law enforcement.

title: America's Book of Secrets
description:
S04 E04 — FBI vs. MLK
In 1962, Martin Luther King Jr. criticized Hoover's FBI for refusing to prosecute white supremacists who had burned down Black churches in Albany, Ga.; Hoover took King's criticisms as a personal insult, and he ordered the FBI to investigate King.

title: History's Crazy Rich Ancients
description:
S01 E08 — Mega Mausoleums
The ancients realized they were destined to spend more time in the tomb than the throne room and spent big to build luxurious final resting places for themselves and their loved ones.

title: History's Crazy Rich Ancients
description:
S01 E10 — Holy Rollers
Meeting the ancients who bankrolled the construction of massive churches and temples in an attempt to buy their way past the pearly gates.

title: History's Crazy Rich Ancients
description:
S01 E11 — Sick Rides
Whether it's private planes, private trains or gold-plated limousines, the mega-rich have always flaunted their wealth by buying luxury vehicles, even when the only vehicles to buy were boats, chariots and horse-drawn carriages.

title: Ancient Empires
description:
S01 E01 — Alexander the Great
The greatest conqueror and general in history, Alexander the Great of Macedon built one of the largest empires ever seen in just 13 years.

title: Engineering an Empire
description:
S01 E01 — Greece
The Greek Empire's architecture and infrastructure; host Peter Weller.

title: Engineering an Empire
description:
S01 E08 — Britain: Blood and Steel
The rise and fall of the British Empire.

title: History's Crazy Rich Ancients
description:
S01 E09 — Power Couples
The average American couple will drop five figures on their wedding, but that wouldn't even begin to cover the tab that these big spending couples racked up while throwing history's most baller nuptial celebrations.

description:

Nathanael Greene overcomes a limp and asthma to become one of Washington's most trusted advisors.

description:
Benedict Arnold

description:

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S05 E34 — Tournament Finals
In the final round of the Invitational Tournament, the winning farrier, armorer, blacksmith and modern metalworker face off to forge a wakizashi; the two finalists must then re-create the nodachi, one of the largest Japanese swords.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
Championship Long Swords
Dave Baker revisits five of the most intense championship rounds featuring the top long swords to come out of the forge.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S05 E33 — Tournament: Round 4
Four bladesmiths must harvest materials from a metal sculpture to forge a needle point Damascus blade; the remaining smiths return to their own home forges to re-create a sword from the elite classes of Renaissance Europe: the Flamberge Rapier.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S05 E30 — Tournament: Round 1
Four bladesmiths are tasked with creating a san mai blade from horseshoes and hoof rasps; the remaining two bladesmiths return to their home forges to create a famed weapon of the English Civil War: the mortuary sword.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S05 E31 — Tournament: Round 2
Four bladesmiths must forge a Damascus blade out of something familiar: plate armor; the remaining two bladesmiths head back to their home forges to craft an exotic hybrid of pain and protection: the Hooded Katar.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S05 E32 — Tournament: Round 3
Four bladesmiths must forge a signature Damascus blade using steel from tools; the smiths that survive two brutal rounds of testing return to their home forges to recreate a multipurpose Medieval weapon of war: the Knightly Poleaxe.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S01 E03 — Viking Battle Axe
The bladesmiths have to turn a steel train spring into a weapon of their choosing; only two competitors will move on and are given only five days to forge a legendary Viking Battle Axe.
